notes_en:
Restore L1-first Lookup/Core search, harden glosses, fold word-choice into synonyms
1. **Fix**: Normal search in AI Lookup or Pure Core keeps local dictionary L1 first, then combined AI; Bypass (⭐) still skips the lexicon.
2. **Improved**: Lookup / short-phrase meanings require lexical glosses; Core adds a short `gloss` (monolingual-aware).
3. **Simplified**: Removed the separate Word Choice Contrast module; why-choose-headword lives in synonym `whenToUse` (mental fit).
